value.summary: Drip Coffee has filed a lawsuit against Kimco Realty, alleging fraudulent practices. The article from GuruFocus.com reports this legal action without providing further details on the specific nature of the fraud claims. The stock news item is part of a broader feed of financial and corporate news.
value.title: Drip Coffee Sues Kimco Realty for Fraudulent Practices

value.summary: Cipla Ltd. has accused Gilead Sciences Inc. of misusing a patent lawsuit concerning Cipla's generic version of the HIV drug Descovy to circumvent a 2022 confidential settlement. Cipla denies Gilead's allegations that its new drug application infringes seven patents related to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), one of Descovy's active ingredients, and claims Gilead has been executing a "decades long product hopping strategy."
value.title: Cipla Flips Gilead’s ‘End Run’ Claim in Descovy Patent Fight

value.summary: CVRx stock rose after Humana announced Medicare Advantage coverage for its Barostim therapy, effective May 1, 2026. This policy expands patient access to the heart failure treatment and covers both FDA-approved indications and patients in the BENEFIT-HF trial. The news follows other favorable reimbursement developments earlier in 2026 and is expected to strengthen CVRx's commercial position and drive future revenue growth in the neuromodulation devices market.
value.title: CVRx Stock Up on Humana's Medicare Coverage for Barostim Therapy

value.summary: Citigroup and BlackRock's HPS Investment Partners have partnered to launch a €15 billion ($17.5 billion) program aimed at expanding direct lending in the EMEA region. This initiative will provide capital solutions and private financing for corporate and sponsor-owned borrowers. The collaboration seeks to enhance access to private capital markets across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
value.title: Citi and BlackRock's HPS team up for $17.5B program to expand direct lending in EMEA (C:NYSE)

value.summary: Ford is currently in discussions with European and North American governments to supply trucks and all-terrain vehicles for military use. This initiative aims to utilize commercially available vehicles to reduce high costs and long production times associated with purpose-built military hardware.
value.title: Ford in talks to supply military vehicles to European governments (F:NYSE)

value.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has disclosed significant changes to its investment portfolio, including a new $2.65 billion stake in Delta Air Lines and a small investment in Macy's. The company also more than tripled its stake in Alphabet and doubled its stake in the New York Times. These moves follow the promotion of Greg Abel to CEO, with major sales including Amazon.com, UnitedHealth Group, Visa, and Mastercard.
value.title: Berkshire buys Delta, more Alphabet; sheds Amazon, UnitedHealth, Visa and Mastercard

value.summary: Valens Semiconductor (VLN) reported a Q1 basic EPS loss of US$0.08 and revenue of US$16.9 million, indicating continued profitability concerns despite stable revenue. The company's trailing twelve-month revenue stands at US$70.7 million with a net loss of US$31.6 million, and it is expected to remain unprofitable for at least the next three years. Investors are focused on the path to narrowing losses, with the stock trading at a P/S of 4.5x compared to an industry average of 8.7x, while forecast revenue growth is 18.8% per year.
value.title: Valens Semiconductor (VLN) Q1 EPS Loss Reinforces Market Focus On Profitability Concerns
